Method of Attack: Replaces legitimate ADFS DLL with malicious version to manipulate user authentication certificates and modify claims in tokens

Hooks legitimate ADFS functions to subvert certificate inspection, accept non-valid client certificates with specific OID values, allow malicious certificate requests to pass, and add fraudulent claims
Enables authentication as any user on compromised ADFS server, providing persistence and pivoting opportunities
Attack Vector: Requires admin access to target ADFS server to replace DLL with malicious version
Indicators of Compromise: Replacement of Microsoft.IdentityServer.Diagnostics.dll with backdoored version featuring additional section in TraceLog class
Unsigned DLLs in Global Assembly Cache (GAC)
